verdict.rationale: doola's documented Partner API covers entity-level records programmatically. It can create customers, submit formations, retrieve formation documents, and read a company's compliance calendar and annual-report filings. Registered agent service is bundled with every API formation, but no evidence shows endpoints to read or manage registered-agent appointments; the RA service is documented only through doola's dashboard. missing for 10: documented API endpoints to read/manage registered-agent appointments, a general entity-record read/update endpoint beyond formations, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read or manage entity records and registered-agent appointments programmatically through a documented public API

citations.quote: The doola Partner API lets you create customers, submit company formations (LLC or C-Corp), retrieve formation documents, and look up reference data.
A company's compliance calendar lists the recurring obligations doola tracks to keep it in good standing.
Read what a state asks and charges, put a company's annual report on file, confirm it, and follow it to completion.
Registered Agent Included with every formation, in all 50 U.S. states.
